words.definition: n. 回归线；热带地区

examples.en: The Tropic of Cancer passes through the northern part of the region.
examples.zh: 北回归线穿过该地区北部。

examples.en: Disease spreads quickly in the tropics during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 雨季时疾病在热带地区迅速传播。

words.usage: 名词，大写专有：the Tropic of Cancer 北回归线、the Tropic of Capricorn 南回归线；复数 the tropics 热带地区。形容词形式 tropical 热带的

confusables.note: adj. 营养的，加一个 h

synonyms.note: n. 赤道，相邻地理概念
n. 亚热带，相邻纬度带

collocations: the Tropic of Cancer 北回归线
the Tropic of Capricorn 南回归线
in the tropics 在热带地区
words.mnemonic: tropic 希腊语「转」处：太阳至此折返 → 回归线

words.definition: adj. 多重的，多种的；n. 倍数

examples.en: The driver suffered multiple injuries in the collision.
examples.zh: 司机在碰撞中多处受伤。

examples.en: Twelve is a multiple of three.
examples.zh: 十二是三的倍数。

words.usage: 形容词，多重的、多种的：multiple choice 多项选择、multiple injuries 多处伤；名词指倍数：the least common multiple 最小公倍数。词根 multi（多）

confusables.note: n. 大量，同 multi 词头

synonyms.note: adj. 众多的，接可数名词
adj. 各种各样的，重多样

collocations: multiple choice 多项选择
multiple injuries 多处受伤
a multiple of three 三的倍数
words.mnemonic: multi(多)+iple → 多份叠加 → 多重的；倍数

words.definition: n. 对称（性）；匀称

examples.en: The palace is admired for the perfect symmetry of its design.
examples.zh: 这座宫殿因设计的完美对称而受人称赞。

examples.en: There is a certain symmetry between the two economic crises.
examples.zh: 这两次经济危机之间存在某种对称性。

words.usage: 不可数名词，对称（性）、匀称：the axis of symmetry 对称轴、bilateral symmetry 左右对称；引申两事物间的对应。派生 symmetric(adj.)、asymmetry 不对称

confusables.note: n. 同情，同 sym 词头

collocations: the axis of symmetry 对称轴
bilateral symmetry 左右对称
in perfect symmetry 完全对称
words.mnemonic: sym(相同)+metry(测量) → 两侧量得一样 → 对称

words.definition: n. 症状；征兆，征候

examples.en: A high fever is often the first symptom of the disease.
examples.zh: 高烧常是该病的首发症状。

examples.en: Analysts see the bankruptcy as a symptom of deeper troubles in the sector.
examples.zh: 分析人士认为这次破产是该行业更深层次困境的征兆。

words.usage: 可数名词，症状：clinical symptoms 临床症状、withdrawal symptoms 戒断症状；引申（问题的）征兆：a symptom of deeper malaise 更深痼疾的征兆
collocations: clinical symptoms 临床症状
withdrawal symptoms 戒断症状
a symptom of decline 衰落的征兆
words.mnemonic: sym(同)+ptom(降) → 与病同降之物 → 症状；征兆

words.definition: n. 保险丝；导火索；v. 熔合

examples.en: All the lights went out when the fuse blew.
examples.zh: 保险丝烧断时，所有的灯都熄灭了。

examples.en: The composer fused jazz with classical music.
examples.zh: 这位作曲家把爵士乐与古典音乐融为一体。

words.usage: 可数名词，保险丝、导火索：blow a fuse 烧保险丝（喻大发脾气）；动词熔合：fuse A with B 使熔合。派生 fusion n. 聚变，confuse 使混乱

confusables.note: n. 大惊小怪，一字母差

collocations: blow a fuse 烧断保险丝；大怒
fuse into 熔合成
a short fuse 急性子；坏脾气
words.mnemonic: fus(熔)+e → 电流过大即熔断 → 保险丝；熔合

words.definition: v. 嘀咕，低声抱怨；n. 嘀咕

examples.en: He muttered something about the unfairness of the decision.
examples.zh: 他低声嘀咕着说这个决定不公平。

examples.en: She sat alone, muttering to herself in the corner.
examples.zh: 她独自坐在角落里自言自语。

words.usage: 动词兼名词，低声含糊地说、嘀咕抱怨：mutter to oneself 自言自语、mutter about sth 抱怨某事。比 murmur 更带怨气，mumble 重在含糊不清

synonyms.note: v. 含糊说，重在听不清

collocations: mutter to oneself 自言自语
mutter about sth 嘀咕抱怨
mutter under one's breath 低声嘀咕
words.mnemonic: mutter 拟声「妈哒」：嘴里嘟哝 → 嘀咕；抱怨

words.definition: n. 旁路，支路；vt. 绕过，避开

examples.en: The new motorway bypasses the town to the east.
examples.zh: 新高速从城东绕过该镇。

examples.en: Do not bypass the safety checks merely to save time.
examples.zh: 不要只为省时间而跳过安全检查。

words.usage: 及物动词，绕过、避开：bypass the city centre 绕开市中心、bypass regulations 规避规章；名词旁路、（心脏）搭桥：bypass surgery 搭桥手术

confusables.note: n. 副产品，by- 同前缀

collocations: bypass surgery 搭桥手术
bypass the problem 绕开问题
a bypass road 绕行道
words.mnemonic: by(旁)+pass(过) → 从旁边过去 → 绕过；旁路

words.definition: n. 隧道，地道；v. 挖隧道

examples.en: The train disappeared into the tunnel beneath the mountain.
examples.zh: 火车钻进山下隧道，消失不见了。

examples.en: Engineers tunneled through solid rock for two years.
examples.zh: 工程师们在坚硬的岩石中掘进了两年。

words.usage: 可数名词，隧道、地道：the Channel Tunnel 英法海峡隧道、tunnel vision（喻）一孔之见；不及物动词挖隧道：tunnel into 或 through 挖进、挖穿

confusables.note: n. 海峡，差头两个字母

collocations: dig a tunnel 挖隧道
tunnel vision 一孔之见
the Channel Tunnel 海峡隧道
words.mnemonic: tun(大桶)+nel：凿出桶形洞 → 隧道；地道

words.definition: n. 恃强凌弱者；vt. 欺负，威吓

examples.en: The older boys bullied the newcomer into giving up his lunch.
examples.zh: 高年级男生欺负新来的孩子，逼他交出午餐。

examples.en: Schools must take firm action against bullying.
examples.zh: 学校必须对欺凌行为采取坚决措施。

words.usage: 可数名词，恃强凌弱者；及物动词欺负、威吓：bully sb into doing sth 胁迫某人做某事。派生 bullying n. 欺凌：school bullying 校园欺凌、cyberbullying 网络霸凌
collocations: bully sb into sth 胁迫某人
school bullying 校园欺凌
play the bully 恃强凌弱
words.mnemonic: bull(公牛)+y → 像牛一样横冲直撞 → 欺负

words.definition: n. 矮子，侏儒；vt. 使相形见绌

examples.en: The skyscrapers dwarf the older buildings around them.
examples.zh: 摩天大楼使周围的旧建筑显得矮小。

examples.en: In the fairy tale, Snow White lived with seven dwarfs.
examples.zh: 在童话里，白雪公主和七个小矮人住在一起。

words.usage: 可数名词，复数 dwarfs 或 dwarves，矮子、神话小矮人；及物动词使显得矮小、使相形见绌：be dwarfed by the towers 在高楼映衬下显得矮小

confusables.note: n. 码头，尾三字母同 arf

collocations: be dwarfed by 相形见绌
dwarf star 矮星
seven dwarfs 七个小矮人
words.mnemonic: dw(向下)+arf：往矮处长 → 矮子；使…显矮

words.definition: n. 自治，自治权；自主（权）

examples.en: The region was granted greater autonomy in managing its schools.
examples.zh: 该地区获得了管理本区学校更大的自治权。

examples.en: Teenagers often demand more autonomy from their parents.
examples.zh: 青少年常常要求父母给更多自主权。

words.usage: 不可数名词，自治（权）、自主：regional autonomy 区域自治、grant sb autonomy 给予自主权；形容词 autonomous 自治的、自动驾驶的。词根 auto 自己+nom 法则
collocations: regional autonomy 区域自治
grant autonomy 授予自治权
personal autonomy 个人自主
words.mnemonic: auto(自己)+nomy(法则) → 自己立法 → 自治；自主

words.definition: v. 用力拉，拽；n. 猛拉；拖船

examples.en: The child tugged at his mother's sleeve for attention.
examples.zh: 孩子拽着母亲的袖子想引起注意。

examples.en: The old photographs tugged at her heartstrings.
examples.zh: 这些旧照片牵动着她的心弦。

words.usage: 及物或不及物动词，用力拉、拽：tug at one's sleeve 拉某人的袖子；名词猛拉、拖船（即 tugboat）；tug of war 拔河；tug at one's heartstrings 扣人心弦
collocations: tug of war 拔河
tug at one's sleeve 拉袖子
tug at the heartstrings 扣人心弦
words.mnemonic: tug 与 tough 一音之转：拉得很费劲 → 猛拉

words.definition: adj. 无用的，徒劳的；无益的

examples.en: All their attempts to save the company proved futile.
examples.zh: 他们挽救公司的一切努力都付诸东流。

examples.en: It is futile to argue with someone who refuses to listen.
examples.zh: 与拒绝倾听的人争论是徒劳的。

words.usage: 形容词，徒劳的、无益的：a futile attempt 徒劳的尝试；句型 it is futile to do sth 做…也是徒劳。派生 futility n. 徒劳。近义 vain：in vain 徒然

confusables.note: adj. 易碎的，f- 开头近形

synonyms.note: adj. 徒劳的，in vain 固定短语

collocations: a futile attempt 徒劳的尝试
futile resistance 无谓的抵抗
prove futile 终归徒劳
words.mnemonic: fut(倒,如 pour)+ile(易) → 易倒空的 → 徒劳

words.definition: adj. 沉默的，哑的；vt. 消音，减弱

examples.en: She stood mute before the crowd, unable to answer.
examples.zh: 她站在人群前一言不发，无法作答。

examples.en: He muted the microphone during the break.
examples.zh: 休息时他把麦克风调成静音。

words.usage: 形容词，缄默的、哑的：as mute as a fish 一声不吭；名词哑巴、弱音器；及物动词消音、减弱：mute the sound 静音、mute criticism 弱化批评
collocations: mute the sound 调成静音
as mute as a fish 缄默不语
a mute appeal 无声的恳求
words.mnemonic: m(闭嘴)+ute：嘴被捂住 → 缄默的；消音

words.definition: n. 软毛，毛皮；皮衣

examples.en: The arctic fox's thick fur protects it from the cold.
examples.zh: 北极狐厚厚的毛皮帮它抵御严寒。

examples.en: Demand for fur has fallen sharply in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近几十年来毛皮需求大幅下降。

words.usage: 不可数名词，（动物的）软毛、毛皮：a fur coat 毛皮大衣；可数指毛皮衣物、一件皮草。习语 the fur flies 掀起风波。派生 furry 毛茸茸的

confusables.note: n. 冷杉，与 fur 同音

synonyms.note: n. 毛发，人体动物通用

collocations: a fur coat 毛皮大衣
fake fur 人造毛皮
fur trade 毛皮贸易
words.mnemonic: fur 谐音「肤」→ 皮肤上的软毛 → 毛皮

words.definition: v. 投降；放弃，交出；n. 投降

examples.en: The besieged soldiers finally surrendered after running out of food.
examples.zh: 被围困的士兵在断粮后最终投降了。

examples.en: He refused to surrender control of the family business.
examples.zh: 他拒绝交出家族企业的控制权。

words.usage: 动词兼名词，投降、放弃、交出：surrender to sb 向某人投降、surrender oneself to 沉溺于；名词 unconditional surrender 无条件投降。反义 resist 抵抗

confusables.note: vt. 包围，仅差一个 e
vt. 克服，m 与 n 之差

collocations: surrender to 向…投降
unconditional surrender 无条件投降
surrender oneself to 沉溺于
words.mnemonic: sur(上)+render(交出) → 举手交枪 → 投降

words.definition: adv. 此外，而且

examples.en: The plan is costly; furthermore, it may harm the environment.
examples.zh: 该计划耗资巨大；此外，它还可能损害环境。

examples.en: Furthermore, the survey data support the earlier findings.
examples.zh: 此外，调查数据也印证了早前的结论。

words.usage: 连接副词，表递进，常置句首并用逗号隔开：Furthermore, the data confirmed…；比 besides 更正式，可替换 in addition，考研写作高频衔接词
collocations: Furthermore, the study shows 此外，研究表明
furthermore note that 并进一步指出
It is furthermore clear 此外同样清楚的是
words.mnemonic: further(更进一步)+more(更) → 更进一步说 → 此外

words.definition: vt. 起诉，检举；继续进行

examples.en: The company was prosecuted for dumping toxic waste.
examples.zh: 该公司因倾倒有毒废物被起诉。

examples.en: The state has a duty to prosecute those who abuse power.
examples.zh: 国家有责任起诉滥用权力者。

words.usage: 及物动词，起诉、检举：prosecute sb for theft 因盗窃起诉某人；正式义继续从事：prosecute a war 进行战争。派生 prosecutor 检察官；反义 acquit 无罪释放

synonyms.note: vt. 起诉，民事诉讼常用

collocations: prosecute sb for 因…起诉某人
prosecute a case 提起公诉
be prosecuted 被追究刑责
words.mnemonic: pro(向前)+secu(追随) → 追着不放 → 起诉；进行

words.definition: vt. 激起，引发；对…挑衅，激怒

examples.en: The article provoked a heated debate among scholars.
examples.zh: 这篇文章在学者中引发了激烈争论。

examples.en: His rude remarks provoked her into losing her temper.
examples.zh: 他粗鲁的言论激得她大发脾气。

words.usage: 及物，常用 provoke sb into doing sth 激怒某人做某事，宾语多为 reaction、debate 类反应名词。派生：provocation n. 挑衅；provocative adj. 煽动性的

synonyms.note: 激怒，指反复惹恼；provoke 可蓄意挑衅
触发，引发连锁反应，中性

collocations: provoke a debate 引发争论
provoke a reaction 引起反应
provoke sb into doing sth 激怒某人做某事
words.mnemonic: pro（向前）+voke（喊）→ 冲前喊叫 → 挑衅，激怒

words.definition: adj. 单调乏味的；迟钝的；暗淡的 vt. 使变钝；缓和，减轻

examples.en: The lecture was so dull that half the audience dozed off.
examples.zh: 讲座枯燥得让一半听众打起了瞌睡。

examples.en: The painkiller dulled the ache in his shoulder.
examples.zh: 止痛药缓解了他肩膀的疼痛。

words.usage: 多作形容词：a dull book 枯燥、a dull color 暗淡；动词义「使变钝，缓解」dull the pain。派生：dullness n. 沉闷；dully adv. 迟钝地

synonyms.note: 无聊，通用；dull 兼指迟钝、暗淡
冗长乏味，书面色彩更浓

collocations: a dull book 枯燥的书
dull the pain 缓解疼痛
dull weather 阴沉的天气
words.mnemonic: 谐音「多了」→ 废话多了就乏味
